verdict: Windows 10 in-place upgrade TS stops after the OS upgrade completes. WMF 5.1 was installed on the source Win7/8.1 AFTER the final cumulative update, leaving a Win10-incompatible `WMIMigrationPlugin.dll` in place.
fix: On the source image, install the latest Windows 7 or 8.1 cumulative update AFTER installing WMF 5.1. The CU ships the Win7-compatible `WMIMigrationPlugin.dll` and corrects the migration metadata. Alternately, uninstall WMF 5.1 before upgrade if WMF is not required in-flight. In most modern environments, Win7/8.1 sources are rare; this rule fires mostly on legacy OS migration projects.
